name: skill-creator
instructions:
Interactive interview and collaborative design tool that helps users define, research, name, generate, and validate complete Codex skills with SKILL.md, scripts, references, assets, ADRs, and traceability.

Capabilities:
- apply skill creator methods within explicit skill-dev boundaries
- analyze interactive interview and collaborative design tool that helps users define, research, name, generate, and validate complete codex skills with skill.md, scripts, references, assets, adrs, and traceability with assumptions, constraints, and failure modes
- produce and validate a skill-dev artifact with evidence, decisions, and next steps

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/skill-dev/skill-creator/SKILL.md
handoff_description: The user has completed the interview and generated a valid skill structure, or an existing skill has been validated with the supported tooling.
